results.title: Pope talks with Putin, signals recovery
results.description: ROME -- Pope Leo XIV gave strong indications Friday that he was recovering well from lung cancer surgery and was very much in charge of running the Catholic Church, speaking on the phone with Russian President Vladimir Putin, meeting with top aides and celebrating Mass in a makeshift hospital chapel.

results.title: From UP to Assam, how a home away from home shaped an IAS officer
results.description: From leaving Uttar Pradesh to finding her feet in Assam, IAS officer Srishti Singh reflects on how a year in an unfamiliar place helped her embrace new challenges and discover herself beyond the demands of public service.
